title: Updating the outward walk counter
statement: Let a machine state have natural-number registers $(N,L_g,s,s_1,X,w,K,B_s,U,V,T,T_2,Z,C,ch,c,c_1)$, and let its register vector list these values in that order, indexed from $0$ to $16$. Replacing coordinate $10$ of the vector by a natural number $k$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by setting $T=k$ and leaving the other registers unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: state has the listed natural-number registers
coordinate vector lists registers in the displayed order
replacement value k is a natural number
replaced:
Let a machine state be a tuple of seventeen natural-number registers, and let its
register vector list these registers in order, with the outward walk counter in
coordinate $10$. Replacing that coordinate of the register vector by $k$ gives the
register vector of the state obtained by setting the outward walk counter to $k$.
